about: Settings for a class of machine, written for 1401 from what a verified setup of that machine needs. A recipe applies when the scan's board name contains one of 'boards' and its CPU name contains one of 'cpus' (whole-word, case-insensitive, like known_machines.json). Unlike a known-machine row it can set kernel quirks and the CPUID emulation. status: works = the owner reached the desktop with it; opt-in = applies only when the build asks for it; theory = derived from a verified setup of the same CPU class, not yet booted on this board. Every effect is recorded in the build report under the rule 'machine-recipe'.

recipes.title: Dell XPS 13 Plus (9320), 12th and 13th-gen hybrid P-series
recipes.source: an owner's published setup for this laptop on macOS 26 (desktop with every P and E core running); the mechanism was re-derived from the kernel's topology code, not copied
recipes.why: ProvideCurrentCpuInfo reports the 4 performance + 8 efficiency core part with a core count per package of 128 while CPUID leaf 1 reports 64 logical processors, so the kernel computes threads per core as 64 / 128 = 0 and divides by it in cpu_thread_alloc: the machine freezes right after EXITBS with E-cores enabled. Setting the logical-processor field of CPUID leaf 1 (EBX bits 23:16) to 128 makes the two agree.

recipes.title: Huawei MateBook X Pro 2023 (MRGFG-XX), i7-1360P
recipes.source: 1401's own scan of this machine on 2026-11-11 (HUAWEI MRGFG-XX-PCB, 13th Gen Intel Core i7-1360P, 12 cores, Raptor Lake-P) and the CPUID mechanism verified on the Dell XPS 13 Plus 9320 with the same i7-1360P; this board has not yet booted macOS in this project, so the row is marked theory, not works
recipes.why: The i7-1360P is the same 4 performance + 8 efficiency core part as the XPS 13 Plus 9320 recipe: with ProvideCurrentCpuInfo on, the CPUID leaf 1 logical-processor field must agree with the kernel's per-package count or cpu_thread_alloc divides by zero right after EXITBS. The value is applied because the same CPU and the same hybrid topology are present; it is unverified on this board and must be confirmed by a real boot before the row becomes works. If the board freezes after EXITBS with E-cores enabled, this is the first setting to review.
